items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Hal Hall, bass player; Herman Autrey, trumpet, and we were getting ready to go to Chicago.

ctx.x: I missed that completely, because of Kirkaby, let him talk me out of it, because I had been back with Stuff -- I mean with Claude Hopkins. Now, I went with -- I'm trying to think of her name again, that went with Stuff,

aaah, where we rehearsed, Slick Jones, drummer; Jobertug, Joe Beeters, Al tenor saxophone player; Hal Hall, bass player; Herman Autrey, trumpet, and we were getting ready to go to Chicago. (unintelligible).
Well this sounds like he's putting a whole new group together.
